evidence.conclusion: Provider-native reasoning control cannot be an enforcement dependency for this route.

detection.scope: structured Contract Runtime calls whose contract requires a final artifact
false_positive_controls: a_complete artifact remains subject to existing converter and validators

recommended_implementation.principle: Observe provider-neutral shape before normalization, classify before conversion, and recover only inside the existing immutable route schedule.
steps: Adapters populate an always-available typed ProviderOutputShapeV1 on ModelResponse without retaining raw content.

ModelGateway._complete_resolved evaluates the exact predicate for structured final-artifact contracts and raises ReasoningOnlyFinalArtifactError with counts, hashes, finish reason, and receipt identity only.

The existing structured_route_qualifications store records reasoning_only_output_limit as an immediate negative qualification bound to provider, model, route fingerprint, execution mode, contract, and schema.
execute_contract_runtime handles the typed error separately from generic output_limit: no output-budget expansion, no repeat of the same route fingerprint, and no sticky output-limit amplification.
Runtime may continue only to a distinct already-configured eligible attempt. If none remains it raises FinalArtifactCapabilityExhaustedError and preserves accepted checkpoints and authority state.
recommended_implementation.guarantee_boundary: This guard prevents misclassification and repeated use of a proven incapable fingerprint. It does not manufacture a final artifact or partition provider tokens inside one generation. Success without a terminal result is possible only when the existing schedule contains another eligible distinct route.
recommended_implementation.normal_outputs: Text or tool-bearing outputs continue through the current converter and validators unchanged.

capability_memory.historical_ptr7_seed: No automatic import from report files. Any live qualification seed is a separately approved state mutation.
